_about: Safe Counter rules. This file is the source of truth for roles, approval rules and fields. All data in this pack is synthetic.

counter.label: Counter staff
counter.description: Serves customers at one shop: hire-outs, returns, deposits, contact details.

technician.label: Technician
technician.description: Checks and repairs returned equipment at one shop.

manager.label: Shop manager
manager.description: Runs one shop. Approves money and customer-contact changes.

area_admin.label: Area admin
area_admin.scope: several shops, one shop per request
area_admin.description: Manager rights in each assigned shop, plus write-offs and ID-check references. Acts inside one shop per request; no request spans shops.

ai_service_identity.label: AI scribe (not a person)
may: create proposals for the records in its task scope
may_not: name an approver or set a decision
propose changes outside its task scope (other shops, other records, other fields)
decide whether a change is sensitive
change its own prompt, rules, approval settings or this file

approval_rules.rule: A person changing a normal field they may change: applies now.
A person changing a sensitive field: applies now if they hold an approver role for it; otherwise it waits for approval.
Every AI proposal waits. For a normal field, anyone who may change that field can approve it, including the person who wrote the note. For a sensitive field, only an approver role.
Nobody approves their own pending change. An AI proposal is not anyone's own change, so a manager may approve one in their own shop.
A rejected proposal can never be applied later, by any path. Every decision records who, when and why.
The server decides what is sensitive, from this file (including value rules such as a write-off). Never a label supplied by the AI.
Every applied change writes its audit row in the same transaction as the change.

fields.format: ISO 8601 in shop local time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-23T16:40:00+01:00

_note_on_other_columns: Records carry other columns (for example rental.deposit_held_pence, rental.hired_at, item.asset_tag). Only the fields listed above can be changed through proposals or edits.
